title: A tracking change reaches the part's core in the same save, and a core added later takes the part's state
custom_preconds: Env https://sv10647.qa.shopview.com (S2 shop), location "Staging Heavy Duty". API calls are replayed from Chrome DevTools (Network tab: copy the request the screen sent, edit, resend) against sv10647api.qa.shopview.com with header X-Location-ID = the current location. Logged in as (a) Admin or a default Parts Manager. Data: QAPL-C1 (tracked, Core Charge > 0, so it has a core); a category with no COGS override. Before the run, get the part id of QAPL-C1's core from an API response in the DevTools Network tab (the core has no row on the Inventory list and its Part History page has no on-screen link); if no response exposes it, mark the case Blocked as dev-verified (gap analysis S5-E3 note). No DB access: values the handoff checks in the DB are verified through the API response, the UI and Part History instead. Keep DevTools Network open.
custom_steps:
1. Open QAPL-C1 from /parts/inventory, switch "Track quantities and cost of goods" off and click Save; read the POST /api/inventory/parts/change response.
  2. Open /parts/history/{corePartId} by address (the core's own Part History page).
  3. Click New Inventory Part and create an untracked part: Description "QA S5 core later", Part Number "QA-S5-CORE-{run}", Category, Cost, Core Charge left empty, switch off, Save.
  4. Reopen QA-S5-CORE-{run}, enter a Core Charge greater than 0 and click Save; take the new core's part id from an API response in the Network tab.
  5. Reopen QA-S5-CORE-{run}, switch tracking on and Save; then open /parts/history/{newCoreId} by address.
  6. Cleanup: reopen QAPL-C1, switch tracking on and Save; reload /parts/history/{corePartId}.
custom_expected:
1. 201 with data.is_tracked: false for QAPL-C1; the row reads "Not Tracked" without a reload.
  2. The page opens and its newest entry is "Tracking turned off", written by the same save (core untracked together with its part).
  3. The part is created; its row reads "Not Tracked".
  4. 201; the part still reads "Not Tracked" and the new core has no row of its own on the Inventory list.
  5. The part shows "{n} available"; the new core's history shows "Tracking turned on", proving the core was untracked and is tracked again together with its part.
  6. QAPL-C1 shows "{n} available" again; the core's history adds "Tracking turned on" from the same save.
